diagnosis: Check C5 passed in all 4 rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF3. The model consistently outputs a departure time of '4:00 p.m.' in its decisions, which is a common default value for end-of-school-day scenarios, allowing it to satisfy C5 without knowing the specific requirement set by PF3.

C5.why: The family transportation confirmation changes the attendance days from Tuesday/Thursday to Monday/Wednesday and sets the required departure time at 4:00 p.m.

commitments.detail: Tuesday and Thursday afternoons from 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. with Ms. Lane as supervisor

fix_instructions: Tighten check C5 by requiring the departure time to be specifically different from common defaults (e.g., not 4:00 p.m.) or by adding a secondary condition that requires the model to explicitly reference the family transportation confirmation to justify the 4:00 p.m. departure time.
